purpose: Exploratory paired recorded-dashcam sign detection comparison; 65 assistant-labeled fixed frames, not a release acceptance test

label_rules.target: Recognizable traffic-sign faces in the 1024 window; annotate boxes for all such visible faces
label_rules.ignore: Sign backs, unreadably tiny or ambiguous shapes, clipped targets; explicit ignore boxes
label_rules.label_origin: Assistant visual review of source-only frames before model outputs; not independent human annotation

replay_metadata.preprocessing: OpenCV orientation-auto once, proportional full-height linear resize, rightmost1024, left pad114
replay_metadata.timestamp_scope: Decoder-reported video PTS; no capture-UTC or GPS mapping inferred
replay_metadata.latency_scope: predict wall time; excludes decode, window resize and evidence writing; not phone latency

targets.description: blue direction board with yellow insert

limitations: Assistant labels, not independent human ground truth
Only fixed 30-second frames labeled; correlated video samples
Only recognizable sign faces >=20px in fixed mobile window
No classifier/OCR/state-machine, face/plate or phone-performance acceptance

default_end2end_keyframes.purpose: Default end-to-end head quality on 65 frozen keyframes only
default_end2end_keyframes.timing_scope: 65 keyframes in a separate run; not directly comparable to full replay latency

findings.review_kind: post-hoc model-selected qualitative episode; outside frozen headline metrics
findings.interpretation: YOLO26s detects the wet-road supplementary panel at 506 s (~0.45), but misses it at frozen 510 s keyframe. This is a frame-level regression, not evidence of losing the entire encounter.

findings.review_kind: post-hoc model-selected qualitative episode; outside frozen headline metrics
findings.interpretation: YOLO26s misses the frozen 150 s chevron frame but detects a chevron at 150.5 s (~0.48) and a clipped chevron at 149.5 s (~0.35). Native source frames and pixel hashes checked; do not infer a complete missed encounter from the fixed-frame regression.
